DescribeRequest.description: What the terrain holds: its extent, files, cache and counts.

extent.description: The box the terrain's cells cover; null until its mesh has been read.

files.description: Each terrain file a decoder reads, as its header states it.

cache.description:
Each cache entry as it stands; empty for the synthetic terrain,
which has no cache.

validation.description: The last live validation's figures; null when none has run.

DescribeResponse.description: What a terrain is, which files answer for it, and how much of it is known.

min_x.description: The south-west corner: its `x`, the least, in meters.

min_z.description: The south-west corner: its `z`, the least, in meters.

max_x.description: The north-east corner: its `x`, the greatest, in meters.

max_z.description: The north-east corner: its `z`, the greatest, in meters.

Box.description: An axis-aligned box in DCS metres, the canonical region.

class.description:

Lua source and `assets.assets`, which have no header.

CacheEntry.description:
One cache entry: `current`, `missing`, or `stale` with the reason.
`size` is its file's bytes, null when there is none.

Counts.description:
How many of each thing the terrain holds. The tables' counts are always
given; road edges and scenery objects are null until a request in the
same process has read the road graph or the scenery.

los_agreement.description: The share of sightlines on which `visible` agreed with the sim.

route_ratio.description: Route length over the sim's own route length.

Validation.description: The figures a live validation sortie measured against the running sim.

region.description: The area to read over, with `step`.

step.description: Meters between points read inside `region`, at least the cell size.

layers.description: The layers to read, such as `height`, `slope`, `cover` and `dist_road`.

max_rows.description: More rows than this is an error, never a truncated answer.

geojson.description: Also return a point per row as GeoJSON.

SampleRequest.description:
Read terrain layers at points or over a grid.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned box between two corners.

z.description: The center: meters east of the terrain's origin.

airdrome.description: The airdrome the ring is about.

points.description: The corners, each `[x, z]` in meters.

Polygon.description: A simple polygon as `[x, z]` vertices, closed by its first point.

AirdromeRef.description:

`name_id`, else its display name, else its id written in digits.

x.description: Meters north of the terrain's origin.

z.description: Meters east of the terrain's origin.

distance_capped.description: Some distance found nothing within its cap and reads as the cap.

geojson.description:
A point per row with its layer values, when `geojson` was asked
for.

SampleRow.description:
Over a region, `height` is bilinear between cell centers and every other
layer the cell holding the point; at given points, the ground layers are
the mesh triangle's own and the derived layers the cell's. A value is
null where the layer is undefined.

to_latlon.description: Points to convert to latitude, longitude and MGRS.

to_xz.description: Latitudes and longitudes to convert to DCS x and z.

GeoRequest.description: Convert between DCS x and z and latitude and longitude.

LatLon.description: A latitude and longitude on WGS84.

GeoResponse.description: Each list in the order of the request's.

GeoPoint.description:
A position in WGS84 degrees, with its MGRS reference to the meter; the
reference is null outside 80° S to 84° N, where MGRS uses polar grids.

z.description: The site: meters east of the terrain's origin.

footprint.description: The site's size, tried at each orientation.

criteria.description: The tests the site is judged by.

orientations_deg.description:
The bearings to try the depth along, in degrees from north towards
east.

Footprint.description: A rectangle to be placed, tried at each of its orientations.

deg.description: The steepest slope allowed, in degrees.

oneOf.description: Steepest slope over the footprint, at most `deg`.

m.description: The largest height difference allowed, in meters.

oneOf.description:
Highest minus lowest height over the footprint's corners and center,
at most `m`.

classes.description: The water classes allowed: land, lake, sea or river.

oneOf.description: Every footprint cell's water class is one of `classes`.

Scenery objects overlapping the footprint, at most `max`.

deg.description: The least mean elevation, in degrees.

oneOf.description:
How enclosed the site is: the mean of its horizon's elevation, at least

bearing_deg.description: The sector's center, in degrees from north towards east.

half_width_deg.description: Degrees either side of the bearing.

min_elev_deg.description: The least horizon elevation, in degrees.

A ridge that way: every horizon bin in the sector rises at least

observers.description: Who looks, each with an eye height above the ground.

targets.description: The points the site must see, each with a height.

The fraction of `targets` the site sees from `own_alt_agl`, at least
`min_fraction`.

threshold_m.description: The relief that counts, in meters.

oneOf.description:
The site's landform class is one of `classes`, judged at
`threshold_m` of local and regional relief.
Every footprint cell has ground. Always applied.

Criterion.description:
One criterion, written `{"name": "slope_max", "params": {"deg": 8}}`.
`valid` takes no params and is applied whether asked for or not.

x.description: Meters north of the terrain's origin.

z.description: Meters east of the terrain's origin.

alt_agl.description: The eye height above the ground, in meters.

Observer.description: Someone looking: a position and an eye height above the ground.

x.description: Meters north of the terrain's origin.

z.description: Meters east of the terrain's origin.

alt.description: The height above sea level, in meters.

alt_agl.description: The height above the ground, in meters.

Point3.description:
A point with a height, given either absolute or above the ground.

Exactly one of `alt` and `alt_agl` is set; `Point3::check` reports both or
neither as an issue. The pair is two fields rather than an enum so the JSON
reads `{"x": .., "z": .., "alt_agl": 2}`, the way a caller writes it.

TpiClass.description:
A landform class from local relief, then regional relief, then slope:
the first that holds of `ridge`, `valley`, `upper`, `lower`, `mid`, and
`flat` otherwise.

score.description:
The sum of the term scores, as `find_sites` ranks with every weight
1.

geojson.description: The site and its footprint, when `geojson` was asked for.

ScoreSiteResponse.description:
The site at its best orientation: one that passes every hard test if
any does, the highest score among those, the first given on a tie.

Term.description:
One criterion's contribution: the measured `value`, whether the hard test
passed, and the soft score from 0 to 1.

footprint.description: A site's size, tried at each orientation.

criteria.description: The tests a site must pass; their scores rank the sites.

step.description: Meters between candidates tried; twice the cell size when omitted.

spacing.description: No two candidates returned are closer than this, in meters.

weights.description: Weight per criterion name in the ranking sum; 1 for any not named.

geojson.description: Also return the candidates and their footprints as GeoJSON.

FindSitesRequest.description: Find the best sites for a footprint in a region.

geojson.description: Each candidate and its footprint, when `geojson` was asked for.

a.description: The point looking, with its height.

b.description: The point looked at, with its height.

geojson.description: Also return the answer as GeoJSON.

VisibleRequest.description: Whether one point sees another over the terrain.

blocking.description: The first terrain point in the way, with an absolute `alt`.

clearance_m.description:
The least vertical gap between sightline and terrain; negative when
blocked.

geojson.description:
The sightline, its ends and the blocking point, when `geojson` was
asked for.

observer.description: Who looks, with an eye height above the ground.

radius.description: How far to look, in meters.

target_alt_agl.description: The height above the ground a cell is seen at, in meters.

Mask cell size in meters; the file's cell size when omitted, and may
be coarser.

as_polygons.description: Also return the visible area as polygons.

geojson.description: Also return the visible area as GeoJSON.

visible_fraction.description:
The share of the cells within `radius` that have ground which are
seen.

rings.description:
The outlines of the set cells as `[x, z]`, north then east, when
`as_polygons` was asked for: each polygon counterclockwise on a map,
then the holes in it clockwise, so a hole is told by its winding.

geojson.description:
The visible area as one `MultiPolygon`, with the observer, when

ViewshedResponse.description:
The mask is `height` rows running north, each `width` cells running
east, from the corner at `origin_x`, `origin_z`; cell `(row, col)` is bit
`row × width + col`, most significant first within each byte, base64
encoded. A set bit is a cell whose center lies within `radius` and at
which a target `target_alt_agl` above the ground is seen.

site.description: The radar, with its height above the ground.

radius.description: How far to look, in meters.

resolution.description:
Raster cell size in meters; the file's cell size when omitted, and may
be coarser.

points.description: Answer at these points instead of over a raster.

bands_agl.description: The heights above ground the bands are drawn at.

geojson.description: Also return the bands, or the points, as GeoJSON.

bands.description: The share of the raster's cells seen at each band, lowest first.

floor_agl.description:

floor_msl.description: The same as an altitude above sea level.

seen_fraction.description:

asset.description: An area whose coverage is reported on its own.

least. Roads only.

How much more a meter off the road costs than a meter of road on

first road it reaches. The straight line to the nearest road is judged
too.

Its length weighted by how hard its ground is to cross, in meters of
open flat ground; null when it is blocked.

blocking.description: Where it enters the first cell that blocks it, when one does.

reason.description: Why it is or is not passable, for a reader.

Straight.description: The straight line from the start to the nearest point of the network.

geojson.description: Also return the answer as GeoJSON.

PointInfoRequest.description: The ground at each point and what lies near it.

points.description: In the order of the request's.

places_built.description:
Whether the places were built, so a null `place` means outside
every one; `dcsterrain index` builds them.

geojson.description:
A point per request point with its fields, when `geojson` was asked
for.

height.description: The water surface over water, the ground elsewhere.

depth.description: Meters of water over the bed; null on land.

slope.description: Degrees from level; null where a neighboring cell has no ground.

aspect.description:
The downslope direction in degrees clockwise from grid north, DCS
`x`; null on ground flatter than half a degree.

town.description: Null when the terrain lists no towns.

place.description:
The place whose outline holds the point; null outside every place,
and while the places are still being built.

road.description:
The nearest point of the nearest road; null when the terrain has
none.

airfield.description: Null when no airdrome has a position.

mgrs.description: Null outside 80° S to 84° N, where MGRS uses polar grids.

PointInfo.description:
What stands at one point. The ground fields are the mesh triangle's own
and null where no mesh covers the point; `slope` and `aspect` are the
cell's holding it. Every distance is in DCS meters, along the flat
x–z plane the game measures in.

bearing_true_deg.description: From the town to the point, clockwise from true north at the town.

bearing_grid_deg.description: From the town to the point, clockwise from grid north, DCS `x`.

compass.description: The true bearing's point of the eight-point compass.

description.description: Such as "6 km NE of Zugdidi"; "at Zugdidi" within 50 m of it.

TownFix.description: The point placed from its nearest town, as a reader would say it.

PlaceRef.description: The place a point stands in.

SizeClass.description: A place's size, from its buildings and its floor.

oneOf.description: One built-up area, its buildings close together.
A strung-out spread of buildings no gap separates.
Several named towns grown together.

Form.description: How a place is laid out.

airdrome.description:
A number is the airdrome's id; a string is its `name_id`, else its
display name, else its id written in digits.

fits.description: An airframe's size: each stand then says whether it fits.

geojson.description: Also return the answer as GeoJSON.

AirfieldInfoRequest.description: An airdrome's runways, stands, radio and navaids.

helicopter.description:
A helicopter needs a stand helicopters may use; an airplane one
airplanes may.

Airframe.description: An airframe's size in meters, which the caller supplies.

id.description:
Null where no file gives it one; the airdrome is then named by its
`name_id`.

name.description: Its first beacon's name, or its `name_id` where it has none.

x.description: The mean of its runway ends; null with no runway.

elevation.description:
The highest ground along any runway's centerline, over the mesh
triangles; with no runway on the mesh, the highest ground at a stand.
Null with neither on the mesh.

navaids.description: Each beacon of the airdrome, in the order the files list them.

stand_sizes.description: How many stands there are of each size, widest first.

stands_fitting.description: How many stands the airframe `fits` names fits; null without it.

geojson.description:
Each runway as a line between its thresholds and each stand as a
point, when `geojson` was asked for.

AirfieldInfoResponse.description:
One airdrome. Courses are true, from true north at the threshold they
leave, and grid, from DCS `x`; there is no magnetic model.

designator.description: Both ends' designators, the first threshold's first: "22-04".

course_true_deg.description:
From the first threshold to the second, clockwise from true north
at the first.

course_grid_deg.description: The same, from grid north, DCS `x`.

length.description: Threshold to threshold, in the x–z plane.

width.description:
Across the runway surface the mesh paints, the median of its width
at nine stations from a tenth to nine tenths of the way along; null
where the mesh paints none there.

thresholds.description: The first threshold, then the second.

RunwayInfo.description: A runway between its two thresholds, the ends the taxi graph names.

height.description: The ground at the threshold; null off the mesh.

course_true_deg.description: Towards the other threshold, clockwise from true north here.

Threshold.description: One end of a runway, and the course a landing on it flies.

kind.description:
Such as `tacan`, `vor_dme`, `ils_localizer` or `airport_homer`, the
game's beacon type without its `BEACON_TYPE_` prefix; null for a
type the game does not name.

kind_code.description: The game's code for the type.

callsign.description: Its English callsign, or the first language's where it has none.

hf_hz.description: HF, the low VHF band (FM), the high VHF band and UHF.

RadioInfo.description: A radio station, such as the tower.

height.description: The tallest airframe it takes; null where the class gives none.

shelter.description: Always null: no file says whether a stand is a shelter.

fits.description:
Whether the airframe `fits` names fits: false where any known size
or use fails it; null without `fits`, or where none fails it but one
is unknown.

StandInfo.description:
A parking stand. Its size fields are null where the files give it no
class.

geojson.description: Also return the answer as GeoJSON.

ValidatePlacementsRequest.description: Whether things to be placed fit the ground under them.

id.description: The name its answer is labeled with.

x.description: Its center: meters north of the terrain's origin.

z.description: Its center: meters east of the terrain's origin.

heading.description: Degrees from north towards east; turns only a `Rect`.

shape.description: What it covers: a point, a rectangle, a circle or a polygon.

on.description: What must be under it: `land` or `water`.

max_slope_deg.description: Degrees, 0 to 90: the steepest slope allowed under the shape.

min_depth.description:
Meters: the shallowest water allowed under the shape, for `on:
water` only.

Placement.description:
Something to be placed: its shape at `x, z`, which is also its label
point, and what it needs of the ground under it. The tool knows nothing
of units: the caller gives the size and the needs.

oneOf.description: The position alone.

Centered on the position, `depth` along `heading` and `width`
across it.
Centered on the position.

points.description: The corners, each `[x, z]` in meters.

oneOf.description:
Absolute DCS `[x, z]` vertices, 3 to 1 000, closed by the first,
inside by the even-odd rule.

PlacementShape.description: Lengths are meters, at most 10 km.

placements.description: In the order of the request's.

geojson.description:
A point per placement with its issues, its shape unless it is a
point, and each object it meets, when `geojson` was asked for.

cells.description: The cells read: 1 for a point.

min_depth.description: Meters: the shallowest water, null where none is water.

cover.description:
Each cover class under the shape, in the order the classes are
listed: a placement in forest says so here.

objects_met.description:
The scenery objects the shape meets; the issues list the nearest
100 to the position.

PlacementCheck.description:
One placement checked. The ground fields read every cell the shape
covers part of, each at its center, or a point's own ground; null where
none of them has any.

oneOf.description: Under the shape, ground no mesh covers.
For `on: land`, water of this class under the shape.
For `on: water`, land under the shape.

For `on: water`, water shallower than `min_depth`; `depth` is the
shallowest.
The steepest cell, over `max_slope_deg`.

A scenery object the shape meets: a building, wall or other
structure of the objects pool by its box, a power-line pole by its
box, a tree by the circle inscribed in its box.

airdrome.description: Its `name_id`; null with the runway when the terrain lists none.

oneOf.description:
The airfield's paved surface. The terrain's files mark runway,
taxiway and apron alike, so the issue names the runway whose
centerline is nearest the shape, and how near.

PlacementIssue.description:
One thing wrong with a placement and what it is. Where an issue names a
place, `x, z` is the offending cell's center, or the point's own
position, nearest the placement's; for `slope` the steepest cell and
for `shallow` the shallowest.

region.description:
Places whose center lies in it; every place of the terrain when
omitted.

size.description: Only places of these size classes; any class when empty.

form.description: Only places of these forms; any form when empty.

min_buildings.description: Only places with at least this many buildings.

sort.description: What places are ranked by: `buildings` or `floor`.

outlines.description:
Each place's outline: its buildings buffered by 100 m, rasterized at
50 m, traced and simplified to within 25 m.

geojson.description: Also return the answer as GeoJSON.

TownsRequest.description: The towns and villages of an area or of the whole terrain.

TownsSort.description: What places are ranked by, most first, ties by id.

matched.description: How many places pass the region and the filters, before the limit.

geojson.description:
A point at each place's center, and its outline when `outlines`
was asked for, when `geojson` was asked for.

id.description:
The least scenery object id among those that count, stable while the
scene file is.

name.description: The town of the terrain's list that names it; null when none does.

other_names.description: Other towns of the list it holds, largest first.

x.description: The mean of its buildings' positions.

bbox.description:
The box of its whole group, buildings that only link included, so it
can reach well past the center, counts and outline.

hectares.description: The 100 m cells holding one of its buildings.

outline.description:
Polygons, each its exterior ring then its holes, as `[x, z]`
vertices; when `outlines` was asked for.

PlaceInfo.description:
A place: buildings each within 200 m of another, three or
more.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable: `snake_case`, never reworded once shipped.

path.description:
Where in the request, dotted: `criteria.2.params.deg`. Empty when the
issue is not about one field.

Issue.description:
One thing wrong with a request or with the file it was asked of. An
operation returns a full result or a list of these, never a partial.

id.description:
Any JSON value but null, returned as given on the line that answers
this one; null is no id.

BatchRequest.description: One line of a batch: an operation and its request.

line.description:
The line of the input this answers, the first being 1, blank lines
counted.

op.description: The operation the line named; absent when it could not be read.

oneOf.description: The response of the operation the line named.

BatchResponse.description: The line answering one line of a batch, in the order they came.
